blocks.text: DevOps Transformation

Microsoft Workloads on AWS

We possess specialized expertise in migrating your entire Microsoft estate—Windows Server, SQL Server, and .NET apps—to AWS and architecting modernization pathways to boost agility and reduce licensing costs.
Architecting Your Modernization Journey
'Lift-and-shift' feels like just moving the problem. What's the real value?

We view lift-and-shift (re-hosting) as the critical first step, not the final destination. The immediate value is a rapid exit from aging data centers, resulting in immediate cost savings and increased resilience. This initial ROI then funds the strategic second step: a phased, intelligent modernization of your applications to unlock the full agility and innovation of the cloud.
